sources.entry: Rambox - Cross Platform messaging and emailing app that combines common web applications into one.

summary.one_liner: Rambox Community Edition is a free, open-source, cross-platform desktop app that combines common web messaging and email applications into one window, but the project is no longer maintained.
summary.what_it_does: The README describes Rambox CE as a free, open-source messaging and email app for Windows, Mac and Linux that bundles common web applications into one interface with tabs. Listed features include reordering tabs, notification badges, minimize to tray, muting individual services, disabling a service without removing it, start on system startup, custom code injection, keyboard shortcuts, proxy support, and a vertical tab bar option. It also offers a master password, a lock feature for when you step away, a do-not-disturb mode, and settings sync across computers. Sessions persist between launches via Webview partitions until a service is removed. Sync uses Auth0 for single sign-on and token-based authentication. The README includes a developer quickstart using git clone, npm install, sencha app watch and npm start.
use_cases: combine several email and chat accounts in one app
keep messaging services open and signed in
mute or disable individual web apps temporarily
sync app configuration across multiple computers
lock a desktop messaging app when away
notable: Combines multiple web messaging and email services into a single tabbed app
Sessions persist across restarts via Webview partition settings
Per-service controls: mute audio, disable without removing, notification badges
Settings sync across computers with Auth0 single sign-on
caveats: The Community Edition is no longer maintained; the README directs users to the new Rambox version, which has a free plan.
Sync feature relies on Auth0 for authentication and storing service configuration.
Running from source requires Sencha tooling and Node.js setup, with more detail in a separate Contributing.md file.
keywords: combine email and chat in one window
self hosted alternative to multiple tabs
